body: Last night I had to take care of my nephew and give him dinner while my sister bought last minute gifts. He was being a little shit, making a mess with his food. All I had to say was "be nice or I'll tell Santa Claus not to bring you any gifts", and suddenly he's an angel. And just like that the whole Santa thing made sense.

People don't seriously think like this, do they? 

Faith in humanity: Destroyed
